description: Pseudophosphatase comparison panel: can a PTP1B substrate phosphotyrosine be placed in the SDF-9, IA-2, IA-2beta and STYX pockets?
code:
import requests, numpy as np, itertools
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse(txt,chain=None):
    res={};order=[];het=[]
    for L in txt.split('\n'):
        if len(L)<54: continue
        rec=L[:6]
        if rec not in ('ATOM  ','HETATM') or L[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
        rn=L[17:20].strip(); ch=L[21]; nm=L[12:16].strip()
        if len(L)>=78 and L[76:78].strip()=='H': continue
        x=np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])])
        if chain and ch!=chain: continue
        if rec=='ATOM  ' and rn in AA3:
            k=int(L[22:26])
            if k not in res: res[k]={'rn':rn,'atoms':{}}; order.append(k)
            res[k]['atoms'][nm]=x
        elif rec=='HETATM' and rn!='HOH': het.append((ch,rn,int(L[22:26]),nm,x))
    return dict(res=res,order=order,het=het)
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0);qc=Q.mean(0);V,S,Wt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
    return V@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt))])@Wt,pc,qc
GRP={}
for g in ['AVLIMC','FWY','STNQ','DE','KRH','GP']:
    for c in g: GRP[c]=g
def sc(a,b): return 3 if a==b else (1 if GRP.get(a)==GRP.get(b) else -2)

PY=parse(requests.get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/1PTY.pdb',headers=H,timeout=120).text,chain='A')
rP=PY['res']; bb=['N','CA','C','O']
pl_P=list(range(212,225))
seqP=''.join(AA3[rP[i]['rn']] for i in pl_P)
P=np.array([rP[i]['atoms'][a] for i in pl_P for a in bb])
ptr=[h[4] for h in PY['het'] if h[1]=='PTR' and h[2]==323 and not h[3].startswith('H')]
print('PTP1B P-loop',pl_P[0],'-',pl_P[-1],seqP,' pTyr heavy atoms',len(ptr))

targets=[('SDF-9 (C. elegans)','AF','https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-G5EGA9-F1-model_v6.pdb',None),
         ('IA-2 / PTPRN (human)','PDB','https://files.rcsb.org/download/2I1Y.pdb','A'),
         ('IA-2beta / PTPRN2 (human)','PDB','https://files.rcsb.org/download/2QEP.pdb','A'),
         ('STYX (human)','AF','https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q8WUJ0-F1-model_v6.pdb',None),
         ('PTP1B C215S trap','PDB','https://files.rcsb.org/download/1G7F.pdb','A'),
         ('PTP1B apo (control)','PDB','https://files.rcsb.org/download/1SUG.pdb','A')]
MAIN={'N','CA','C','O','CB'}
rows=[]
for name,kind,url,ch in targets:
    r=requests.get(url,headers=H,timeout=150)
    if r.status_code!=200:
        print(f'{name}: download failed HTTP {r.status_code}, skipped'); continue
    T=parse(r.text,chain=ch); rT=T['res']
    order=[i for i in T['order'] if all(a in rT[i]['atoms'] for a in bb)]
    seqT=''.join(AA3[rT[i]['rn']] for i in order)
    # ungapped sliding-window match of the PTP1B P-loop
    best=sorted(((sum(sc(a,b) for a,b in zip(seqP,seqT[k:k+13])),k) for k in range(len(seqT)-12)),reverse=True)
    s0,k0=best[0]
    win=order[k0:k0+13]; wseq=seqT[k0:k0+13]
    S=np.array([rT[i]['atoms'][a] for i in win for a in bb])
    R,pc,qc=kabsch(S,P); rms=np.sqrt((((S-pc)@R+qc-P)**2).sum(1).mean())
    toP=lambda X:(X-pc)@R+qc
    def nclash(trunc_all=False,cut=2.6):
        C=[]
        for ri,rv in rT.items():
            for nm,x in rv['atoms'].items():
                if trunc_all and nm not in MAIN: continue
                C.append(toP(x))
        C=np.array(C)
        return int(sum(np.linalg.norm(C-p,axis=1).min()<cut for p in ptr))
    # Arg221 equivalent position and distance to the substrate phosphate
    PHOS=[h[4] for h in PY['het'] if h[1]=='PTR' and h[2]==323 and h[3]=='P'][0]
    rargi=win[9]  # position aligned to PTP1B R221
    arg=rT[rargi]
    dP=min(np.linalg.norm(toP(x)-PHOS) for nm,x in arg['atoms'].items() if nm in ('NH1','NH2','NE')) if arg['rn']=='ARG' else float('nan')
    rows.append(dict(name=name,seq=wseq,first=win[0],rmsd=rms,clash=nclash(),clash_tr=nclash(True),
                     nuc=AA3[rT[win[3]]['rn']],arg=AA3[rT[rargi]['rn']],dP=dP,score=s0,margin=s0-best[1][0]))
    print(f'{name:26s} window {win[0]}-{win[-1]} {wseq}  (score {s0}, margin over next {s0-best[1][0]}) '
          f'bbRMSD {rms:.2f} A  clash {nclash()}/17  trunc {nclash(True)}/17  nucleophile {AA3[rT[win[3]]["rn"]]}  Arg221-eq {AA3[rT[rargi]["rn"]]}'
          + (f'  guanidinium-P {dP:.2f} A' if dP==dP else ''))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.4))
nm=[r['name'].split(' (')[0].replace(' / ','/') for r in rows]
x=np.arange(len(rows)); w=0.38
ax[0].bar(x-w/2,[r['clash'] for r in rows],w,label='full side chains',color='firebrick')
ax[0].bar(x+w/2,[r['clash_tr'] for r in rows],w,label='side chains cut to CB',color='salmon')
ax[0].set_xticks(x); ax[0].set_xticklabels(nm,rotation=25,ha='right',fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_ylabel('pTyr heavy atoms clashing (<2.6 A)'); ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_title('Can the PTP1B substrate pTyr be placed in each pocket?')
ax[1].bar(x,[r['rmsd'] for r in rows],color='steelblue')
for i,r in enumerate(rows):
    ax[1].text(i,r['rmsd']+0.02,f"{r['nuc']}/{r['arg']}",ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_xticks(x); ax[1].set_xticklabels(nm,rotation=25,ha='right',fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_ylabel('P-loop backbone RMSD to PTP1B (A)')
ax[1].set_title('P-loop geometry and nucleophile/Arg identity')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
